marathon_condition: The project is complete only when a repeatable answer to power asymmetry survives observed use across domains and jurisdictions without displacing equivalent asymmetry elsewhere.

legs.title: Freeze one Matt Clifford decision file
legs.result: The AI Opportunities Action Plan to implementation-adviser sequence supports actor-specific institutional translation while self-selection, recommendation authorship, decision-specific conflict mitigation and advice-to-outcome causation remain open.

legs.title: Close or terminate Matt Clifford × Anduril
legs.result: One summit-process overlap survives; no published bilateral instrument, named-award effect or common-purpose compact survives the frozen denominator.

legs.title: Independent NGC2 responsibility and acceptance file
legs.result: Army mission and program sovereignty, differentiated Anduril, Palantir, Raft and Lockheed roles, and bounded operational integration are supported; final acceptance, meaningful human veto, rights and end-to-end custody remain open.

legs.title: One Palantir represented-person chain
legs.result: ELITE-supported geographic prioritization reaches direct person-level consequence, delayed evidence access and R3/R4 judicial counterpower; individual identification, sole causation, software correction, deletion and private benefit do not close.

legs.title: Find and test an R6 co-governance candidate
legs.result: German works-council law and BAG 1 ABR 7/15 support a binding collective right over introduction and use of a technical monitoring function, while individual veto, platform-purpose control, deletion and transfer remain absent or open.

legs.title: Find and test an R7 value-recovery candidate
legs.result: TARP CPP joins public capital and crisis risk to preferred returns, warrants, fair-value disposition, a transaction-specific positive return and final program net income; direct affected-person recovery, full social-cost recovery, co-governance and cross-sector transfer do not follow.

legs.title: Raise M-04G source health toward 75 percent
legs.result: The poller now separates execution, route, content, coverage and evidence states and adds staggering, host-aware retries, safe redirects, metadata fallback and classified failures. One post-merge all-class orbit must establish the observed result.

answer_library.name: notice_and_voice
answer_library.limit: Notice often arrives only after an institution has acted.

answer_library.name: inspection_and_correction
answer_library.limit: Inspection may remain litigation-intensive or retrospective.

answer_library.name: pause_and_burden_shift
answer_library.limit: The pause may govern one legal practice without correcting the underlying software record.

answer_library.name: reversal_and_remedy
answer_library.limit: Remedy may be delayed, incomplete or disconnected from compensation, deletion and successor systems.

answer_library.name: substitution_and_public_capacity
answer_library.limit: One bounded public replacement does not prove enterprise-scale substitutability.

answer_library.name: co_governance
examples: German works-council co-determination over technical monitoring
answer_library.limit: The observed authority is collective, representative, statutory and function-bounded rather than full constitutional equality.

answer_library.name: value_recovery
examples: TARP Capital Purchase Program preferred returns and warrants
answer_library.limit: Public fiscal recovery is not direct affected-person recovery and does not establish proportionality to all public risk and social cost.

cross_domain_assessment.reason: The library now contains bounded examples at every level, but no one architecture combines timely notice, inspection, independent pause, effective remedy, durable substitution, represented-party co-governance and proportionate value recovery across the required domains and jurisdictions.

next_marathon_frontier: Construct a combined answer stack from R1 through R7 without treating the examples as interchangeable.
Test the combined stack against at least three domains and two jurisdictions.
Require pre-action timing, direct evidence access, independent authority, observed remedy, durability and practical exit or co-governance in each transfer.
Test whether R6 representation is captured, centralized or bypassed by technical architecture.
Test whether R7 recovery reaches affected people rather than only the public fiscal account.
Track successor systems and displacement of equivalent asymmetry.
Complete the post-repair M-04G all-class orbit and preserve every failed route in the denominator.
